finding.claim: A DER-encoded public key passed as a Buffer with no algorithms restriction is classified as an HMAC secret, so an attacker can forge HS256 tokens signed with the public key bytes (algorithm confusion).
finding.source: Operator key option (Buffer, DER) with algorithms unset; attacker-controlled header alg (verifier.js:162)
finding.sink: verifier.js:524 prepareKeyOrSecret -> createSecretKey(keyBytes); crypto.js:341-345 HMAC verify

trace.note: non-function key goes to detectPublicKeyAlgorithms(key, [])
all-HS shortcut does not apply, allowedAlgorithms empty
Buffer converted with toString('utf-8')
locatePem finds no -----BEGIN header in DER bytes, returns isRawSecret
performDetectPublicKeyAlgorithms returns hsAlgorithms
allowedAlgorithms set to HS256/HS384/HS512
hsAlgorithms.includes(HS256) true -> secret KeyObject from DER bytes
attacker alg HS256 passes allowlist
HMAC over DER bytes compared with timingSafeEqual; matches attacker's HMAC

finding.guards_checked: verifier.js:162 alg allowlist (only auto-detected HS set); crypto.js:88-96 PEM header detection (does not match DER); verifier.js:33-43 prepareKeyOrSecret (no asymmetric-material check); precondition: operator passes DER Buffer with no algorithms option. Not executed; read-only.

finding.claim: Signature segment accepts non-canonical base64url (unused trailing bits ignored), so one valid token has several distinct valid string forms; the code comment at verifier.js:166-168 claims canonical signatures.
finding.source: Attacker holding any valid token edits the last signature character

trace.note: BASE64URL_RE checks alphabet only
signature returned as raw string
verifySignature called with raw signature string
non-canonical trailing bits decode to same bytes

finding.guards_checked: Alphabet regex enforced (decoder.js:41). Signing input is raw header.payload so only signature segment varies. Forgery not possible; only string-form malleability. Impact depends on app denylist keyed by token string.
finding.repro: For HS256 (43-char signature), alter last char among the 4 values sharing the same top 4 bits; each decodes to identical 32 bytes and verifies.
finding.sink_note: Impact limited to applications that key revocation or replay checks on the raw token string.

finding.claim: With caching enabled, a token with exp but no iat is cached with TTL = cacheTTL, ignoring exp, so it is accepted after expiry for up to cacheTTL (default 600000 ms).
finding.source: Attacker holds an expired token lacking iat; cache option enabled

trace.note: hasIat false when iat absent
exp-based TTL block skipped because it is inside if(hasIat)
cacheValue[2] set to maxTTL = now + cacheTTL + tolerance
cache hit checks only min/max, never exp

finding.guards_checked: Live validator verifier.js:311-322 enforces exp on cache miss, so only the cached path is wrong. Tokens with iat are correct (verifier.js:125, :134). Cache is opt-in (verifier.js:84-85, :580). Requires issuer omitting iat.

finding.claim: maxAge is silently not enforced when the token has no iat claim, because the validator is skipped for absent claims.
finding.source: Attacker holds token with no iat (signer noTimestamp, signer.js:96)

trace.note: maxAge pushes iat validator
claim absent -> continue, validator skipped
requiredClaims enforces presence only if operator lists iat

finding.guards_checked: requiredClaims (verifier.js:293-299) not on by default. Fail-open for tokens of unknown age.

finding.claim: With cache enabled, verifying a Buffer token throws a TypeError from hashToken (Buffer has no split), instead of returning a TokenError.
finding.sink: utils.js:46 token.split('.',1) inside hashToken, called via verifier.js:364 cacheKeyBuilder

trace.note: Buffer token accepted by type check
cacheKeyBuilder(token) called when cache enabled
Buffer.prototype.split is not a function -> TypeError
same path repeated in cacheSet

finding.guards_checked: Type check at verifier.js:353 does not convert Buffer to string before cache key. Exception is synchronous, escapes callback path too. Denial of service / 500 in apps that do not catch.
